environment.description: Same Ktor microservice deployed on EKS with hardened pod spec. The container's root filesystem is mounted read-only via securityContext.readOnlyRootFilesystem=true. No tmpfs, emptyDir, or any other writable volume is attached to the pod. The container runtime (containerd with default seccomp profile) enforces the read-only mount propagation at the kernel level via MS_RDONLY on all mount points including /tmp. ENABLE_DEBUG_LOGGING is set to 'true' in the ConfigMap (leftover from staging migration). Process runs as UID 65534 (nobody). JVM flag -XX:-HeapDumpOnOutOfMemoryError is set. No PersistentVolumeClaim is bound.
